title: Emergency Chimney Repair & Creosote Cleaning: Complete Safety Guide
summary: Arborist & fireplace specialist guide on creosote removal, chimney liner inspections, flue safety, and preventing chimney fires.
directAnswer: If you notice heavy smoke backing up into your living room, crackling noises in the flue, or a strong burnt odor, immediately extinguish the fire, evacuate the hearth area, and call a certified chimney repair technician for emergency inspection.

title: Fireplace Inspection & Masonry Tuckpointing: Extending Chimney Lifespan
summary: How professional masonry tuckpointing and chimney cap installation prevent water leaks and structural masonry failure.
directAnswer: Regular annual chimney inspections prevent water intrusion, mortar deterioration, and dangerous carbon monoxide leaks into residential homes.
